General Remarks.

The land sold during the year amounted to 40,163.33 acres, which realized $167,776.88. The quantity of surrendered
land in the hands of the department was approximatively 207,226.04 acres. The principal outstanding, on account of
Indian Lands sold, amounted to $599,765.74, a considerable portion of which has not yet become due.
